intro: Pick a chart type to see live examples, appearance variants, and copy-paste snippets. Components live under `@zentauri-ui/zentauri-components/charts/*` and expect `recharts` as a peer dependency.
useCases: Trend lines and stacked areas on analytics dashboards.
Category bars for funnel or cohort summaries.
Pie and donut charts for part-to-whole summaries.
Consistent tooltips, axes, and density across screens.

faqs.question: Do I need to install Recharts?
faqs.answer: Yes. Add `recharts` to your app so the peer dependency resolves; align the major version with what Zentauri UI tests against.

faqs.question: Do charts work in the Next.js App Router?
faqs.answer: Use them in client components or import from client boundaries—Recharts relies on browser APIs and React state for interaction.

faqs.question: Can I restyle charts with Tailwind?
faqs.answer: Use the `appearance` and `density` variants on the frame plus `className` for layout; inner Recharts elements pick up token-friendly defaults from the wrapper.

sections.heading: What it does
sections.body:
Wraps Recharts Cartesian and scatter primitives with shared margins, axes, grid, tooltip, and legend wiring.

Swap appearance tokens instead of hand-tuning SVG colors for every screen.

sections.heading: Composition and API
sections.body:
Pass `data`, `xKey`, and `series` for most charts. Area and bar support `stacked` when series share a stack id.

Bubble charts use numeric `xKey` and optional `zKey` on each series for bubble size. Pie charts use `dataKey` and `nameKey` for slice values and labels.

sections.heading: Next.js integration notes
sections.body:
Mark preview routes or parents as client components when embedding interactive charts.

Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL so canonical metadata resolves on deploy.
